dedupe_keys.name: future global land datasets at 1 km under ssp rcp scenarios 2015 to 2100 chen li liu

description: This dataset projects global land use and land cover at 1 km from 2015 to 2100 under the IPCC's coupled socioeconomic and climate scenarios (SSP-RCP). Guangzhao Chen and Xiaoping Liu of Sun Yat-sen University and Xia Li of East China Normal University released it on Zenodo in March 2021. It has two sub-datasets: a seven-class land use and land cover product and a plant functional type product with 20 land types. Land demand under each scenario comes top-down from the official CMIP6 land use data, and a cellular automata model allocates it bottom-up in space. Coverage is global at 1 km. Format and access: two ZIP archives of rasters, about 3.7 GB in total, on Zenodo. Licence: CC-BY-4.0; free. Caveats: projections inherit the assumptions of the CMIP6 land demands and the cellular automata rules, and the seven classes are coarse for urban planning. Future losses of forest, wetland and grassland matter for green-blue infrastructure and flood and heat exposure studies. Related catalogue records are the 0.05-degree GCAM-Demeter land use projections and the global 1 km PLUS land use projections for 2020 to 2100.
